summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican reported that articles were drawn up for a prize fight between Charles C. Gallagher and Tom Allen, both of Cleveland, with $200 a side already deposited and the fight set for five weeks later.

metadata.notes: Running head reads 'The Missouri Republican--St. Louis, January 14, 1869'. Before 1888, so not the St. Louis Republic.

facts.fact: Articles of agreement were drawn up for a prize fight between Allen and Charles C. Gallagher, with $200 a side deposited as forfeit money and the fight to take place in five weeks
In January 1869 Allen was described as being of Cleveland, Ohio

notes: The item says the articles were arranged 'last night', i.e. Jan. 13, 1869. It also says a Gallagher-Tom Kelly fight was likely to follow. Allen is a principal, so focus is primary.
